content.short: Dedge Security is the first native security posture management platform for Web3.
content.description: Dedge Security delivers a native security posture management platform for Web3, unifying asset discovery, risk identification, and production monitoring in a single, integrated system. It continuously maps assets across networks and chains, surfaces vulnerabilities and exposures, and tracks live production activity so enterprises and Web3 native companies can expand their security perimeter with confidence. By aligning security outcomes with business goals, it reduces blind spots, speeds up responses, and supports sustainable growth across multi-chain environments.
